scope: Two alternating before/after pairs per workload; public NAPI inode mode, split PGlite roles, volatile configuration, owned persistent server process, 400 iterations/64 workers/4096B writes each; no QUIC/native mounting/production capacity.
limitations: Timed operations exclude setup/cleanup; process disk-byte counters cover full runner window including setup/cleanup/background and observer margins. Short zero write-byte deltas do not prove zero backing writes or durable publication. No fixed physical SSD write-amplification ratio is inferred.

Backing-process byte counters use macOS proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V2, SDK resource.h160-byte layout and monotonic same UUID/start-time checks. They provide bytes, not operation counts. The first before1 lifecycle run preceded this observer and lacks process counters.
Host iostat reports all host traffic, not attributable to this datastore. First since-boot sample discarded; disk4 is the virtual FDB image and must not be added to disk0.
Two short trial pairs are diagnostic; no confidence interval or throughput floor acceptance. Fifteen SQL texts and transaction semantics are unchanged; structural whole-guard rewrite remains.
No allocator profiler or server CPU sampler used here. Kernel resident/footprint before/after values are gauges, not phase peaks. Foreign allocator and full-target profiles remain separate.
